encodable_shape_gain_codec.codebook_training: On WikiText validation calibration activations only, find each token's MSE-optimal clip among fractions 0.40..1.00 of its normalized Hadamard-domain absmax, then form 16 per-layer absolute clip values from fixed 0.5%-99.5% quantiles of those optimal clip targets.
encodable_shape_gain_codec.decoder_requirement: Decoder needs only layer identity, 4-bit angular-scale index, 4-bit radius index, and the A4 element codes; per-layer codebooks are static model metadata.
encodable_shape_gain_codec.representation: h = r u; 4-bit log-RMS radius plus 4-bit index into a frozen per-layer absolute angular clip codebook; normalized Hadamard-domain direction uses symmetric A4 levels -7..7.
encodable_shape_gain_codec.runtime_selection: For each token and layer, choose the 4-bit codebook index minimizing normalized Hadamard-domain reconstruction MSE. No labels, logits, downstream loss, or evaluation-corpus tuning.

frozen_protocol.calibration_transfer: WikiText validation only; frozen unchanged for C4
frozen_protocol.data_construction: Identical token slices and SHA-256 hashes to Gates007/008.

primary_rules.baseline_parity: Dynamic exact-RMS-restored and fixed-grid log4 NLLs must reproduce Gate007/008 within 1e-5 on both corpora.
primary_rules.codec_fidelity: On each corpus, shape_gain_codebook16_A4_log4_radius NLL <= shape_gain_codebook16_A4_exact_radius NLL + 0.10.
primary_rules.oracle_gain_retention: On each corpus, relative to the exact-RMS-restored dynamic baseline, the encodable log4 shape-gain codec must retain at least 70% of Gate008 oracle-log4's NLL improvement.
primary_rules.shape_gain_vs_dynamic: On each corpus, shape_gain_codebook16_A4_log4_radius must beat hadamard_dynamic_A4_exact_RMS_restored and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI of the per-sequence NLL difference must be <0.
primary_rules.shape_gain_vs_fixed: On each corpus, shape_gain_codebook16_A4_log4_radius must beat fixed_shared_angular_A4_log4_radius and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI must be <0.
primary_rules.shape_gain_vs_raw_adaptive: On each corpus, shape_gain_codebook16_A4_log4_radius must beat raw_adaptive_clip_codebook16_A4 and paired-bootstrap 95% upper CI must be <0.
primary_rules.terminal_method_pass: All rules above pass on both corpora.

prohibitions: Do not tune the 16-entry codebooks, quantile endpoints, 70% retention threshold, or pass criteria after evaluation begins.
Do not use evaluation labels/logits/loss to choose scales.
Do not claim latency, energy, or kernel efficiency from this experiment.
purpose: Test whether Gate008's token-adaptive angular-scale advantage can be converted into a decoder-reconstructible low-side-rate residual activation codec, and whether shape-gain separation adds value beyond adaptive clipping of the raw residual itself.

raw_adaptive_clipping_control.interpretation: This isolates whether the separate radius/normalized-direction representation adds value beyond cheap adaptive clipping itself.
raw_adaptive_clipping_control.representation: No shape-gain decomposition. Quantize the raw Hadamard residual directly with A4 using a frozen 16-entry per-layer absolute clip codebook calibrated from raw calibration activations.
raw_adaptive_clipping_control.runtime_selection: Per token, choose the 4-bit codebook index minimizing raw Hadamard-domain reconstruction MSE.

terminal_interpretation.fail: Stop the compression-method lane centered on a separately coded radius. Bank the mechanistic finding that token RMS and token-adaptive directional clipping matter, but do not pursue a standalone method unless a materially new architecture or prior-art gap appears.
terminal_interpretation.pass: Proceed to native BitNet internal quantization-site integration and task-level evaluation. Do not claim broad shape-gain novelty.
